# The game script, tested from the box scores (fit 2025-10-07 → 2026-04-16, test 2026-10-01 → 2026-10-27)

Fit season: 1312 games (2518 team-games with both teams 3+ games in). Test season: 190 games (274 team-games). Every read is built from the games before the date; the coefficients are fitted on the fit season and applied unchanged to the test season. Shrinkage: a team’s shots at 10 games toward the league, its venue split at 10 games toward its season, its goals at 30 games, finishing at 400 shots.

### The model’s own Stage 1 against the fitted one

`model-core.js` sets a team’s expected shots as the sum of its players’ shot anchors (the team’s own volume) × a step on the opponent’s shots allowed a game (31+ → +6%, 29–31 → +2%, else −3%) and on its unblocked attempts allowed (45+ → +6%, 43–45 → +2%, else −3%), × a pace ceiling (±6% at most, left out here: the pace workbook is not public). Its goals: 0.52 × the players’ goal rates + 0.48 × the opponent’s goals allowed, × a step (3.2+ allowed → +8%, 2.6 or fewer → −7%). Rebuilt here from the same season-to-date figures, the team’s raw averages as the anchors.

| Season | Stage 1 shots: deviance | MAE | fitted shots: deviance | MAE | mean said: Stage 1 / fitted / shots taken | Stage 1 goals: deviance | MAE | every team the league’s goals: deviance | fitted shots × the league’s shooting %: deviance |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Fit season | 1.3851 | 4.96 | 1.3022 | 4.83 | 27.9 / 27.8 / 27.8 | 1.0714 | 1.38 | 1.0635 | 1.0494 |
| Fit season, both teams 20+ games in | 1.3655 | 4.92 | 1.2978 | 4.80 | 27.8 / 27.8 / 27.8 | 1.0737 | 1.38 | 1.0845 | 1.0696 |
| Test season | 1.4713 | 4.95 | 1.2670 | 4.66 | 26.9 / 27.0 / 27.5 | 1.1525 | 1.44 | 1.0406 | 1.0118 |

The opponent’s side of Stage 1 is a step that bottoms out at −6% (both steps at −3%). The league allowed 27.8 shots and 43.0 unblocked attempts a team-game last season, so the iFF step reads +6% only for the leakiest few and the shots step’s −3% floor applies to every defense at 28.9 or under. The fitted elasticity on what the opponent allows is 0.92: a defense allowing 24 a game (15% under the league) takes about 13% off a team’s shots, one allowing 32 adds 14%; the step reads −6% and +8 to +12% for the same two.

| + the team’s goals for, the opponent’s goals against (season) | 1.0531 | 1.0406 | 1.40 | 0.03 |
| + shot volume both ways and home | 1.0550 | 1.0187 | 1.39 | 0.14 |
| + finishing and the opponent’s goals per shot against | 1.1601 | 1.0190 | 1.39 | 0.15 |
| + venue splits and last ten (shots), last ten (goals) | 1.1453 | 1.0170 | 1.40 | 0.16 |

Goals for, shooting % and shots are nearly the same read three ways (goals = shots × shooting %), so the models that carry all three fit one half of a season and miss the other; the shots-times-finishing form keeps one of each.

The goals model used below: “Shots × finishing: + the team’s finishing and the opponent’s goals per shot against, shrunk” (the lowest cross-validated deviance of the shots-times-finishing forms). Coefficients (fit season):

| Read | coefficient | z |
| --- | --- | --- |
| tSh | 0.56 | 3.6 |
| oSv | 0.30 | 1.9 |

## 4. Dividing the team’s shots and goals among the skaters by the opponent’s weakness

Each skater’s individual read against a league-average opponent at a neutral venue (the shipped formula’s own rate, attempts and TOI with the league figure at his position in place of the opponent’s, the skater-level home and back-to-back terms off: `tableNone`; or the study’s blended rates, `studyNone`, test season only) × the **script multiplier**, the team’s projected shots tonight over its usual (every term of the full model except its own level: the opponent’s allowing, venue, last ten, rest, possession) × the **position tilt**, the opponent’s share of the shots it allows that go to his position over the league’s share (shrunk toward the league at a pseudo-count of shots, to a power), normalised over the team’s skaters so the tilt divides the volume and adds none. Goals the same from the goals model and the opponent’s share of goals allowed by position.
